column1: You listen as the radio comes alive with your call number... "53mary2, Dispatch...we have further traffic for you."
column2: 你聽見無線電以你的呼號響起……「53mary2，這裡是派遣中心……有進一步通報給你。」

column1: Keith grabs the mike and answers... "Dispatch...53mary2. Go ahead with your traffic."
column2: 基斯拿起麥克風回答……「派遣中心……53mary2。請說明通報。」

column1: 53mary2, 10-4 dispatch continues..."Traffic Officer Haines has located a vehicle belonging to the correctional officer at Oak Tree Mall."
column2: 「53mary2，10-4，」派遣中心繼續說……「交通警員海恩斯在老橡樹購物中心找到一輛屬於矯正員警的車。」

column1: Continuing, "Per Captain Hall, respond to that 10-20 and 11-98 with Officer Haines...Dispatch clear."
column2: 接著說：「依霍爾警監指示，與海恩斯警員一同前往該 10-20，並進行 11-98……派遣中心完畢。」

column1: After acknowledging the radio call, Keith mumbles to Sonny..."Well, you heard it, big boy. Let's roll!"
column2: 確認無線電通話後，基斯對桑尼喃喃說……「好了，大個子，你都聽到了。出發！」

column1: As you drive along, mulling over your thoughts, a call from Dispatch breaks the silence..."53mary2...Dispatch..."
column2: 你開車沉思時，派遣中心的呼叫打破沉默……「53mary2……派遣中心……」

column1: Keith keys the mike... "Dispatch...53mary2. Go ahead..."
column2: 基斯按下麥克風……「派遣中心……53mary2。請說……」

column1: Respond to Cotton Cove...see the jogger standing by at the phone booth.
column2: 「前往棉花灣……查看站在電話亭旁的慢跑者。」

column1: Dispatch continues..."Jogger has info of possible foul play... Be advised I have one traffic unit responding."
column2: 派遣中心繼續說……「慢跑者掌握可能涉及刑案的資訊……請注意，我已派一個交通單位前往。」

column1: Keith keys the mike... "Dispatch...53mary2 copied."
column2: 基斯按下麥克風……「派遣中心……53mary2 收到。」

column1: Great, Keith mutters, "Let's go watch jets take off and land."
column2: 「太好了，」基斯嘟囔，「我們去看飛機起飛降落吧。」

column1: Say, that's Snuggler's Inn. It's a nice motel...uh...I've never actually BEEN there of course...
column2: 「看，那是依偎旅館。是間不錯的汽車旅館……呃……我當然從沒真的去過那裡……」

column1: Finally, something to eat! grunts Keith.
column2: 「終於有東西吃了！」基斯咕噥道。

column1: Shopping early for Christmas? Keith jokes.
column2: 「提早買聖誕節禮物嗎？」基斯開玩笑說。

column1: Maybe we should bring a picnic lunch? Keith suggests sarcastically."
column2: 「也許我們該帶份野餐午餐？」基斯挖苦地提議。

column1: Yeah, grunts Keith. "Let's see if they've managed to keep any bad guys in."
column2: 「對啊，」基斯咕噥道。「去看看他們有沒有成功把壞蛋關在裡面。」

column1: I'm sure there's nothing to worry about, Sonny. But let's not waste any time!
column2: 「我確定沒什麼好擔心的，桑尼。但我們別浪費時間！」

column1: Hey, are you sure you two wouldn't rather be alone?
column2: 「嘿，你確定你們兩個不想單獨相處嗎？」

column1: Keith frowns. "OK." he says, "I have mucho paper work to finish."
column2: 基斯皺眉。「好吧，」他說，「我還有一大堆文書工作要完成。」

column1: Keith pipes up: "Let's go roust some bag ladies, eh Sonny?"
column2: 基斯插話：「我們去盤查幾個提袋女士吧，桑尼？」

column1: Dispatch comes on the air and responds... "53mary2...10-4. Dispatch copies 10-8 from %s."
column2: 派遣中心上線回覆……「53mary2……10-4。派遣中心收到來自 %s 的 10-8。」

column1: Keith keys the mike..."Dispatch...53mary2. Be advised we are enroute to %s."
column2: 基斯按下麥克風……「派遣中心……53mary2。請注意，我們正在前往 %s。」

column1: Dispatch answers..."53mary2...10-4. We copy you are enroute to %s."
column2: 派遣中心回答……「53mary2……10-4。收到你們正在前往 %s。」

column1: Dispatch responds..."53mary2...10-4. Dispatch copies 10-97 %s."
column2: 派遣中心回覆……「53mary2……10-4。派遣中心收到 10-97，前往 %s。」

column1: Keith keys the mike. "Dispatch... 53Mary2. Be advised that suspect Bains may be in possession of the correctional officer's gun."
column2: 基斯按下麥克風。「派遣中心……53Mary2。請注意，嫌犯班恩斯可能持有矯正員警的槍。」
